desc: Ideation: understand the problem and key observations.
Parse N, X, arrays A, B, P, Q (1-indexed).
Write a helper to find the cycle containing X in a given permutation (as a list of boxes in order following the permutation from X).

For red balls: find the cycle in P containing X; among boxes in that cycle that have A_i = 1, find the farthest position from X (max distance along the cycle); mark all boxes from that position back to X (inclusive of X? exclude X from count).
Do the same for blue balls using Q and B_i.
Compute answer = number of distinct marked boxes (excluding X). If a color has no balls in its cycle, ignore it; if no balls anywhere, answer is 0.

Print answer, or -1 if neither red nor blue has a path to X from any ball (i.e., no balls in either cycle) — actually, if there are balls but none in the cycles of X, answer -1; if no balls at all, answer 0.
Test with provided samples and additional edge cases.
